set.body: Two separate acceptance inputs. (1) Authorized private memory-study data are already available and exercised through API comparisons; finish the selected study's authoritative geometry, clocks/time origin, phase/trial identity and display declarations, then qualify the complete production-host G2 journey without source edits. Preserve source digests, permission and unresolved timing/join warnings. Do not ask again for any memory data as if none had been obtained. (2) A-11 / -asc-e2e still needs one permitted redistributable real edf2asc output with known converter options, provenance, digests and reuse terms; private research exports alone do not satisfy that public artifact requirement. Record each input separately.
set.title: Complete real-study provenance/admission (G2) and obtain redistributable EDF-derived ASC (A-11)
